Overview.Title: Overview
Overview.Description: Keep long-term important entries, groups, and campaign values in view.
Overview.PinnedDescription: Mark entries, groups, or values in their respective views to keep them visible here.
Overview.NoPinnedText: Pin important entries, groups, or values to the overview using the thumbtack button.

Campaign.Title: Campaign
Campaign.Description: Manage, collapse, and manually sort chapters, groups, and entries.
Campaign.RootDrop: Drop here to move an element to the top level.
Campaign.EmptyText: Create a chapter or your first entry.

Sessions.Title: Sessions
Sessions.Description: Sessions are started explicitly. Only changes made while a session is active are recorded here.
Sessions.EmptyText: Start the first session when the actual game begins.
Sessions.ManualChangeHint: Changes to campaign entries and trackers are still recorded automatically. You can add extra events, decisions, or notes here manually.

Trackers.Title: Trackers
Trackers.Description: Manage numeric campaign values such as reputation, progress, or collection totals.
Trackers.EmptyText: Create a tracker when you want to follow a long-term numeric value.

Settings.Title: Settings

Settings.JournalButton: Campaign Forge icon in the Journal tab
Settings.JournalButtonHint: Shows a compact button in the Journal tab for opening Campaign Forge.
Settings.StructuralChangesHint: Shows create, edit, delete, and sorting operations in the session view. The data remains recorded regardless of this display setting.
